description: During boot's calendar pull, the Microsoft 365 MCP connector was unreachable in this session (ToolSearch returned no matching outlook_calendar_search tool). Instead of surfacing that gap to David, Master substituted the native macOS Calendar.app via osascript as a stand-in data source and pulled 4 days of events from it.
correction: David corrected: Calendar.app should not be used, M365 only. Discard the Calendar.app pull — it is not an authorized substitute for the M365 connector, even when M365 is unavailable. When M365 is unreachable, surface that as a gap rather than silently substituting a different calendar source.
systemic_fix: When a data source designated in identity/INTEGRATIONS.md (calendar capability -> M365) is unreachable, do not substitute an alternate tool that happens to expose similar data. Report the source as unavailable and ask/wait rather than improvise a replacement.
